input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages. In no event shall either party be liable to the other for the recovery of any special, indirect or consequential damages even if the defendant party had been advised of the possibility of such damages ... The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
input.rationale: Section 15 contains a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and already carves Sections 13 (IP ownership/indemnity, see p0090) and 14 (confidentiality) out of the limitation, but it contains no monetary aggregate cap at all. Direct-damages exposure is therefore unlimited for both parties, including for Sparkling as customer, which fails the playbook requirement of a meaningful mutual cap. The redline inserts a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable by Sparkling and USD 1,000,000, defines Excluded Claims (retaining Sections 13 and 14 and adding data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) as uncapped, and confirms Sparkling's fee obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims and payment obligations excluded from the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but sets no monetary cap, so direct-damages exposure is unlimited for both parties; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. We have kept indemnification, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement (including Sections 13 and 14) outside the cap, and confirmed that Sparkling's fee payments are not "damages"; a straight twelve months' fees cap is an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means breaches of Sections 13 and 14, a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights, and the limitations and exclusions of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to Excluded Claims. Sparkling's obligation to pay fees properly due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages subject to the cap in this Section 15.
